title: Brutus-Pell L8 Exact-Rank Relation and an Explicit q=47 Witness
description: A dated publication-grade record of the Brutus-Pell L8 exact-rank relation for the Pell sequence and an explicit q=47 computational witness. The release separates standard Pell/Lucas facts, the project-specific L8 formulation, the derivation, and the independently verified computational witness.
